presets.name: Steady clicker
presets.description: Clicks 10 times a second with a little natural variation. Press your start key to begin and again to stop.
presets.author: MacroEZ

presets.name: Hold to click
presets.description: Clicks 20 times a second, but only while you hold your start key down. Let go and it stops.
presets.author: MacroEZ

presets.name: Double tap rhythm
presets.description: Double-clicks, pauses, and repeats: a tapped rhythm of two quick clicks and a short break.
presets.author: MacroEZ
